# Complete analysis code and figures

The following section contains the complete analysis code. All R code is shown, while routine package messages and warnings are suppressed. Figures printed by the analysis are displayed directly in the report.

```{r complete-analysis, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
# ================================================================
# 1) Number of Studies by Year and Country
# 2) Evidence Map Across Outcome Domains
# 3) Discontinuation vs STEP RCT Dashed-line Benchmark Graph
# 4) Female Participants
# 5) Hazards Ratio (CVD) vs SELCET Trial
# 6) Mean Percentage Weight Loss Across Follow-up Periods
# 7) Proportion of Patients Achieving Weight-Loss Thresholds at 12 Months or More
# 8) CV Event Rates
# 9) Themes For Discontinuation
# 10) Distribution of Studies WRT Duration of Studies
# 11) Bubble Plot 
# 12) Heat Map
# 13) Merged Heat Map (Data Source, Outcome, Sample Size)
# 14) Discontinuation Themes WRT Follow up Periods

# ================================================================



# ================================================================
# 0. Packages
# ================================================================


required_packages <- c(
  "readxl", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "stringr",
  "scales", "cowplot", "gridExtra", "grid"
)

for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}


# ================================================================
# 1. File Paths
# ================================================================

input_file <- "Result.xlsx"

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  message("Result.xlsx")
  input_file <- file.choose()
}

out_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "Saved_Graphs")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)


# ================================================================
# 2. Helper Functions
# ================================================================

sheet_match <- function(target) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(input_file)
  matched <- sheets[trimws(sheets) == target]
  if (length(matched) == 0) stop(paste("Sheet not found:", target))
  matched[1]
}

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "\\n", " ")
  x <- stringr::str_squish(x)
  x
}

to_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(as.numeric(x))
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "\u2212|\u2013|\u2014", "-")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, ",", ".")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "[^0-9.-]", "")
  x[x == ""] <- NA
  as.numeric(x)
}

save_plot <- function(plot, filename, width = 10, height = 6) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, filename),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

base_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


# ================================================================
# 3. Shared Colours
# ================================================================

color_categories <- c(
  "2022-2023" = "#f16913",
  "2024-2025" = "#e31a1c",
  "2026" = "#41ab5d"
)

country_colors <- c(
  "USA" = "#41ab5d",
  "Spain" = "#6a51a3",
  "Denmark" = "#3690c0",
  "UK" = "#E76F51",
  "Canada" = "#df65b0",
  "China" = "#fe9929",
  "Slovakia" = "#8D6E63"
)

disc_segment_colors <- c(
  "After 1st prescription" = "#ec7014",
  "After 5th prescription" = "#fe9929",
  "Early discontinuation" = "#ef3b2c",
  "Late discontinuation" = "#fb6a4a",
  "Overall discontinuation" = "#41ab5d"
)

legend_order <- c(
  "After 1st prescription",
  "After 5th prescription",
  "Early discontinuation",
  "Late discontinuation",
  "Overall discontinuation"
)


# ================================================================
# Graph 1:
# Number of Studies by Year and Country
# ================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------
# Libraries
# ------------------------------------------------

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readxl)
library(grid)


# ------------------------------------------------
# Output Folder
# ------------------------------------------------

out_dir <- file.path(
  getwd(),
  "Saved_Graphs"
)

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}


# ================================================================
# Publication Trend Data
# ================================================================

publication_trend <- readxl::read_excel(
  input_file,
  sheet = sheet_match("Publication Trend"),
  range = "A1:C6"
)

names(publication_trend) <- c(
  "Year",
  "No_of_Studies",
  "Trend_Line_Data"
)

publication_trend <- publication_trend %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year = as.character(Year),
    No_of_Studies = to_num(No_of_Studies),
    Trend_Line_Data = to_num(Trend_Line_Data)
  )


# ================================================================
# Geographical Distribution Data
# ================================================================

geography_cat <- readxl::read_excel(
  input_file,
  sheet = sheet_match("Geographical Distribution Cat"),
  range = "A3:D10"
)

names(geography_cat) <- c(
  "Country",
  "2022-2023",
  "2024-2025",
  "2026"
)


# ================================================================
# Convert to Long Format
# ================================================================

geography_cat_long <- geography_cat %>%
  
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Country)
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    Country = clean_text(Country)
  ) %>%
  
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    
    cols = c(
      "2022-2023",
      "2024-2025",
      "2026"
    ),
    
    names_to = "Category",
    
    values_to = "Studies"
    
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    Studies = tidyr::replace_na(
      to_num(Studies),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::filter(
    Studies > 0
  )


# ================================================================
# Category Order
# ================================================================

category_levels <- c(
  "2022-2023",
  "2024-2025",
  "2026"
)

geography_cat_long <- geography_cat_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = category_levels
    )
  )


# ================================================================
# Total Number of Studies Per Category
# ================================================================

geo_category_totals <- geography_cat_long %>%
  
  dplyr::group_by(
    Category
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::summarise(
    
    Total_Studies = sum(
      Studies,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = category_levels
    )
  )


# ================================================================
# Publication Totals
# ================================================================

publication_trend_cat <- publication_trend %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    Year_num = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(Year)
    )
    
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    Category = dplyr::case_when(
      
      Year_num %in% c(
        2022,
        2023
      ) ~
        "2022-2023",
      
      Year_num %in% c(
        2024,
        2025
      ) ~
        "2024-2025",
      
      Year_num %in% c(
        2026
      ) ~
        "2026",
      
      TRUE ~
        NA_character_
    )
    
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Category)
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::group_by(
    Category
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::summarise(
    
    Publication_Total = sum(
      No_of_Studies,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
    
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = category_levels
    )
  )


# ================================================================
# X-Axis Position 
# ================================================================

x_positions <- c(
  
  "2022-2023" = 1.00,
  
  "2024-2025" = 2.00,
  
  "2026" = 3.00
  
)


geography_cat_long <- geography_cat_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    Category_x =
      unname(
        x_positions[
          as.character(Category)
        ]
      )
    
  )


geo_category_totals <- geo_category_totals %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    Category_x =
      unname(
        x_positions[
          as.character(Category)
        ]
      )
    
  )


publication_trend_cat <- publication_trend_cat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    Category_x =
      unname(
        x_positions[
          as.character(Category)
        ]
      )
    
  )


# ================================================================
# Maximum Y value
# ================================================================

max_total <- max(
  geo_category_totals$Total_Studies,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


# ================================================================
# Create Graph
# ================================================================

p1 <- ggplot(
  
  geography_cat_long,
  
  aes(
    x = Category_x,
    y = Studies,
    fill = Country
  )
  
) +
  
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Stacked Bars
# ------------------------------------------------

geom_col(
  
  width = 0.75,
  
  color = "white",
  
  linewidth = 0.30
  
) +
  
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Values Inside Each Stack
# ------------------------------------------------

geom_text(
  
  aes(
    label = ifelse(
      Studies > 0,
      Studies,
      ""
    )
  ),
  
  position = position_stack(
    vjust = 0.50
  ),
  
  size = 2.65,
  
  color = "black",
  
  fontface = "bold"
  
) +
  
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Total Number Above Each Bar
# ------------------------------------------------

geom_text(
  
  data = geo_category_totals,
  
  aes(
    x = Category_x,
    y = Total_Studies,
    label = Total_Studies
  ),
  
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  
  vjust = -0.45,
  
  size = 3.0,
  
  fontface = "bold",
  
  color = "black"
  
) +
  
  
# ================================================================
# Country Colours
# ================================================================

scale_fill_manual(
  values = country_colors
) +
  
  
# ================================================================
#  X-Axis
# ================================================================

scale_x_continuous(
  
  breaks = unname(
    x_positions
  ),
  
  labels = names(
    x_positions
  ),
  
  limits = c(
    0.55,
    3.45
  ),
  
  expand = expansion(
    mult = c(
      0,
      0
    )
  )
  
) +
  
  
# ================================================================
#  Y-Axis
# ================================================================

scale_y_continuous(
  
  breaks = seq(
    0,
    max_total + 4,
    by = 2
  ),
  
  limits = c(
    0,
    max_total + 3
  ),
  
  expand = expansion(
    mult = c(
      0,
      0.02
    )
  )
  
) +
  
  
# ================================================================
# Internal Titles + Axis Labels
# ================================================================

labs(
  
  title =
    "Number of Studies by Year and Country",
  
  x =
    "Publication-year category",
  
  y =
    "Number of studies",
  
  fill =
    NULL
  
) +
  
  
# ================================================================
# TUM Style Graph
# ================================================================

theme_minimal(
  base_size = 9
) +
  
  theme(
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Internal Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 10.5,
      
      hjust = 0.5,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        b = 9
      )
      
    ),
    
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# X-Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 9,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 9
      )
      
    ),
    
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Y-Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 9,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        r = 7
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# X-Axis Category Labels
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      
      angle = 0,
      
      hjust = 0.5,
      
      vjust = 1,
      
      size = 7.5,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 5
      )
      
    ),
    
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Y-Axis Numbers
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      
      size = 7.5,
      
      color = "black"
      
    ),
    
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Grid
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    panel.grid.major.x =
      element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.minor =
      element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      
      color = "#D9D9D9",
      
      linetype = "dashed",
      
      linewidth = 0.40
      
    ),
    
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Legend
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    legend.position =
      "bottom",
    
    legend.direction =
      "horizontal",
    
    legend.box =
      "horizontal",
    
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 7.2
    ),
    
    legend.key.width =
      grid::unit(
        0.45,
        "cm"
      ),
    
    legend.key.height =
      grid::unit(
        0.35,
        "cm"
      ),
    
    legend.spacing.x =
      grid::unit(
        0.10,
        "cm"
      ),
    
    legend.margin =
      margin(
        t = 4,
        b = 0
      ),
    
    legend.box.margin =
      margin(
        t = 2
      ),
    
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Plot Margins
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      
      t = 5,
      
      r = 6,
      
      b = 7,
      
      l = 6
      
    )
    
  ) +
  
  
# ================================================================
# Legend Arrangement
# ================================================================

guides(
  
  fill = guide_legend(
    
    nrow = 2,
    
    byrow = TRUE
    
  )
  
)

# ================================================================
# Display Graph
# ================================================================

print(
  p1
)

# ================================================================
# Graph Save
# ================================================================

ggsave(
  
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "1_year_category_country_stacked.png"
  ),
  
  plot = p1,
  
  width = 6.3,
  
  height = 4.5,
  
  units = "in",
  
  dpi = 600,
  
  bg = "white"
  
)

# ================================================================
# Save as PDF
# ================================================================

ggsave(
  
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "1_year_category_country_stacked.pdf"
  ),
  
  plot = p1,
  
  width = 6.3,
  
  height = 4.5,
  
  units = "in",
  
  bg = "white"
  
)

# ================================================================
# File Location
# ================================================================

cat(
  
  "\nPNG saved to:\n",
  
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "1_year_category_country_stacked.png"
  ),
  
  "\n\n"
  
)

cat(
  
  "PDF saved to:\n",
  
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "1_year_category_country_stacked.pdf"
  ),
  
  "\n"
  
)

# ================================================================
# Graph 2: Evidence Map Across Outcome Domains
# ================================================================

evidence_map <- readxl::read_excel(
  input_file,
  sheet = sheet_match("Evidence Map"),
  range = "A1:F14"
)

names(evidence_map) <- c(
  "Outcome_Domain", "Studies_Reporting", "Total_Studies",
  "Percentage", "Evidence_Level", "Interpretation"
)

evidence_map <- evidence_map %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Outcome_Domain)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Outcome_Domain = clean_text(Outcome_Domain),
    Studies_Reporting = to_num(Studies_Reporting),
    Total_Studies = to_num(Total_Studies),
    Percentage = to_num(Percentage),
    Evidence_Level = stringr::str_to_title(clean_text(Evidence_Level))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Percentage)

evidence_colors <- c(
  "Strong" = "#2E86AB",
  "Moderate" = "#F2C14E",
  "Limited" = "#E27D60"
)

p2 <- ggplot(
  evidence_map,
  aes(x = reorder(Outcome_Domain, Percentage), y = Percentage, fill = Evidence_Level)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_colors, na.value = "grey70") +
  labs(
    title = "Evidence Map Across Outcome Domains",
    x = "Outcome domain",
    y = "Percentage of studies",
    fill = "Evidence level"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0)) +
  expand_limits(y = 105)

print(p2)

save_plot(
  p2,
  "2_evidence_map_percentage.png",
  width = 11,
  height = 7
)


# ================================================================
# Graph 3 Data: Discontinuation Data Used for Both P3 Formats
# ================================================================

discontinuation <- readxl::read_excel(
  input_file,
  sheet = sheet_match("Discontinuation rate"),
  range = "A10:C17"
)

names(discontinuation) <- c(
  "Study_Followup",
  "Discontinuation_Rate",
  "Study_Author"
)

discontinuation <- discontinuation %>%
  tidyr::fill(Study_Author, .direction = "down") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Study_Followup), !is.na(Discontinuation_Rate)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Study_Followup = clean_text(Study_Followup),
    Study_Author = clean_text(Study_Author),
    Discontinuation_Rate = to_num(Discontinuation_Rate),
    Study_Followup_lower = stringr::str_to_lower(Study_Followup)
  )

disc_stacked <- discontinuation %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(
      Study_Followup_lower,
      "louise|gasoyan|st-pierre|st pierre"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Study_Group = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(Study_Followup_lower, "gasoyan") ~ "Gasoyan 2025",
      stringr::str_detect(Study_Followup_lower, "louise") ~ "Ladebo 2024",
      stringr::str_detect(Study_Followup_lower, "st-pierre|st pierre") ~ "St-Pierre 2024",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    Segment = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(Study_Followup_lower, "1st prescription") ~ "After 1st prescription",
      stringr::str_detect(Study_Followup_lower, "5th prescription") ~ "After 5th prescription",
      stringr::str_detect(Study_Followup_lower, "early") ~ "Early discontinuation",
      stringr::str_detect(Study_Followup_lower, "late") ~ "Late discontinuation",
      stringr::str_detect(Study_Followup_lower, "st-pierre|st pierre") ~ "Overall discontinuation",
      TRUE ~ Study_Followup
    ),
    Study_Group = factor(
      Study_Group,
      levels = c("Gasoyan 2025", "Ladebo 2024", "St-Pierre 2024")
    )
  )

study_positions <- c(
  "Gasoyan 2025" = 1,
  "Ladebo 2024" = 2,
  "St-Pierre 2024" = 3
)

step_benchmarks <- tibble::tribble(
  ~STEP_Trial, ~Discontinuation_Rate,
  "STEP 1", 7,
  "STEP 5", 5.9
)

followup_legend_df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Study, ~Follow_Up_Duration,
  "Gasoyan 2025\nEarly and late discontinuation", "12 months",
  "Louise 2024\n1st and 5th prescription", "12 months",
  "St-Pierre 2024", "15 months",
  "STEP 1 trial", "68 weeks",
  "STEP 5 trial", "104 weeks"
)

# Create disc_plot_data_2 BEFORE any p3_2 graph is drawn
# This prevents: Fehler: Objekt 'disc_plot_data_2' nicht gefunden
disc_plot_data_2 <- disc_stacked %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Study_x = study_positions[as.character(Study_Group)],
    Stack_Order = dplyr::case_when(
      Study_Group == "Gasoyan 2025" & Segment == "Late discontinuation" ~ 1,
      Study_Group == "Gasoyan 2025" & Segment == "Early discontinuation" ~ 2,
      Study_Group == "Ladebo 2024" & Segment == "After 5th prescription" ~ 1,
      Study_Group == "Ladebo 2024" & Segment == "After 1st prescription" ~ 2,
      Study_Group == "St-Pierre 2024" & Segment == "Overall discontinuation" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 99
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Study_Group, Stack_Order) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Study_Group) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ymin = dplyr::lag(cumsum(Discontinuation_Rate), default = 0),
    ymax = cumsum(Discontinuation_Rate),
    label_y = (ymin + ymax) / 2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


# ================================================================
# Graph 3 Format 1:
# Discontinuation Patterns Across Key Studies
# With STEP benchmark Table, Mini Chart, Duration Table, Note
# ================================================================

disc_plot_data_p3 <- disc_stacked %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Study_x = study_positions[as.character(Study_Group)],
    Stack_Order = dplyr::case_when(
      Study_Group == "Gasoyan 2025" & Segment == "Early discontinuation" ~ 1,
      Study_Group == "Gasoyan 2025" & Segment == "Late discontinuation" ~ 2,
      Study_Group == "Ladebo 2024" & Segment == "After 1st prescription" ~ 1,
      Study_Group == "Ladebo 2024" & Segment == "After 5th prescription" ~ 2,
      Study_Group == "St-Pierre 2024" & Segment == "Overall discontinuation" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 99
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Study_Group, Stack_Order) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Study_Group) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ymin = dplyr::lag(cumsum(Discontinuation_Rate), default = 0),
    ymax = cumsum(Discontinuation_Rate),
    label_y = (ymin + ymax) / 2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

bar_width_p3 <- 0.65

p3_left <- ggplot(disc_plot_data_p3) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = Study_x - bar_width_p3 / 2,
      xmax = Study_x + bar_width_p3 / 2,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      fill = Segment
    ),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = Study_x,
      y = label_y,
      label = paste0(Discontinuation_Rate, "%")
    ),
    size = 4.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = disc_segment_colors,
    breaks = legend_order,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2, 3),
    labels = c("Gasoyan 2025", "Ladebo 2024", "St-Pierre 2024"),
    limits = c(0.55, 3.35),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 60),
    breaks = seq(0, 60, 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Real-World Studies",
    x = "Study",
    y = "Discontinuation rate (%)",
    fill = "Discontinuation category"

# ================================================================
# Graph 5: Cardiovascular Outcomes - Hazard Ratios With 95% CI
# ================================================================

hazard_ratio_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Outcome, ~Source, ~HR, ~LCL, ~UCL,
  "Composite cardiovascular endpoint", "Observational study", 0.73, 0.65, 0.82,
  "Composite cardiovascular endpoint", "SELECT trial",        0.80, 0.72, 0.90,
  "Stroke",                            "Observational study", 0.71, 0.61, 0.81,
  "Stroke",                            "SELECT trial",        0.93, 0.74, 1.15,
  "Myocardial infarction",             "Observational study", 0.68, 0.58, 0.80,
  "Myocardial infarction",             "SELECT trial",        0.72, 0.60, 0.86,
  "All-cause mortality",               "Observational study", 0.60, 0.47, 0.77,
  "All-cause mortality",               "SELECT trial",        0.81, 0.71, 0.93
)

outcome_order_hr <- c(
  "Composite cardiovascular endpoint",
  "Stroke",
  "Myocardial infarction",
  "All-cause mortality"
)

# Shorter/wrapped outcome labels to align the plot better
outcome_labels <- c(
  "Composite cardiovascular\nendpoint",
  "Stroke",
  "Myocardial\ninfarction",
  "All-cause\nmortality"
)

hazard_ratio_data <- hazard_ratio_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcome_order_hr),
    Source = factor(Source, levels = c("Observational study", "SELECT trial")),
    Outcome_num = match(as.character(Outcome), outcome_order_hr),
    y_pos = dplyr::case_when(
      Source == "Observational study" ~ Outcome_num - 0.16,
      Source == "SELECT trial" ~ Outcome_num + 0.16
    ),
    Label = paste0(
      sprintf("%.2f", HR),
      "\n95% CI ",
      sprintf("%.2f", LCL),
      "–",
      sprintf("%.2f", UCL)
    ),
    Label_x = dplyr::case_when(
      Source == "SELECT trial" &
        Outcome %in% c("Composite cardiovascular endpoint", "All-cause mortality") ~ 0.965,
      TRUE ~ UCL + 0.015
    ),
    Label_hjust = dplyr::case_when(
      Source == "SELECT trial" &
        Outcome %in% c("Composite cardiovascular endpoint", "All-cause mortality") ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    Label_y = dplyr::case_when(
      Source == "SELECT trial" &
        Outcome %in% c("Composite cardiovascular endpoint", "All-cause mortality") ~ y_pos + 0.06,
      TRUE ~ y_pos
    )
  )

p5_hazard_ratio <- ggplot(hazard_ratio_data, aes(y = y_pos, color = Source)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = LCL, xend = UCL, yend = y_pos),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = HR), size = 3.5) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = Label_x,
      y = Label_y,
      label = Label,
      hjust = Label_hjust
    ),
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = 3.5,
    lineheight = 0.95,
    color = "black",
    show.Legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Observational study" = "#004529",
      "SELECT trial" = "#F57C00"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(outcome_order_hr),
    labels = outcome_labels,
    trans = "reverse"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.4, 1.26),
    breaks = seq(0.4, 1.1, by = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cardiovascular Outcomes: Hazard Ratios with 95% CI",
    subtitle = "George Komatsoulis, 2025 (11.7 Months) vs SELECT trial (2.9 Years)",
    x = "Hazard ratio (HR)",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 11,
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(r = 8)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.88, 0.14),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 25, 10, 10)
  )

print(p5_hazard_ratio)

# ================================================================
# Graph Save
# ================================================================

save_plot(
  p5_hazard_ratio,
  "5_cardiovascular_hazard_ratios_comparison_aligned_xaxis.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 6.8
)

# ================================================================

bar_width_weight <- 0.50


# ================================================================
# Study Positions
# ================================================================

study_centres_weight <- tibble::tibble(
  
  Study_ID = factor(
    weight_loss_data$Study_ID,
    levels = weight_loss_data$Study_ID
  ),
  
  x_center = c(
    
    1.00,   # Richards, 2023
    
    2.45,   # Xiang, 2023
    
    3.90,   # Miertová Zuzana , 2026
    
    6.00,   # Rubio-Herrera, 2023
    
    7.45,   # Gasoyan, 2024
    
    8.90,   # Michalak, 2024
    
    10.35,  # Carmen D, 2025
    
    11.80,  # Gasoyan, 2025
    
    13.25,  # Richards, 2025
    
    14.70,  # Seier, 2025
    
    16.15   # Toliver, 2025
    
  )
  
)


# ================================================================
# Calculate Bar Positions
# ================================================================

weight_loss_plot <- weight_loss_long %>%
  
  dplyr::left_join(
    study_centres_weight,
    by = "Study_ID"
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::group_by(
    Study_ID
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    n_bars =
      dplyr::n(),
    
    bar_index =
      dplyr::row_number(),
    
    x_pos = dplyr::case_when(
      
      n_bars == 1 ~
        x_center,
      
      n_bars == 2 ~
        x_center +
        (bar_index - 1.5) *
        bar_width_weight,
      
      n_bars == 3 ~
        x_center +
        (bar_index - 2) *
        bar_width_weight,
      
      TRUE ~
        x_center
      
    )
    
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::ungroup()


# ================================================================
# Individual Value Label Adjustment
# ================================================================

weight_loss_plot <- weight_loss_plot %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    label =
      paste0(
        Weight_Loss,
        "%"
      ),
    
    
# ============================================================
# HORIZONTAL LABEL ADJUSTMENTS
# ============================================================
    
    label_x = x_pos +
      
      dplyr::case_when(
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Richards 2023 - 6.4%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Richards, 2023\n12 Weeks" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "3 Months" ~
          0.00,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Xiang 2023 - 11.2%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Xiang, 2023\n6 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "6 Months" ~
          0.00,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Zuzana - 6.45%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Miertová Zuzana , 2026\nSubmaximal dose\n6 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "3 Months" ~
          -0.17,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Zuzana - 11.35%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Miertová Zuzana , 2026\nSubmaximal dose\n6 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "6 Months" ~
          0.06,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Rubio-Herrera - 16.9%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Rubio-Herrera, 2023\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.00,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Gasoyan 2024 - 12.9%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Gasoyan, 2024\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.00,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Michalak - 15%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Michalak, 2024\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.00,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Carmen - 14.1%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Carmen D, 2025\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.09,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Gasoyan 2025 - 10.9%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Gasoyan, 2025\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.12,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Richards 2025 - 8.1%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Richards, 2025\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "3 Months" ~
          -0.12,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Richards 2025 - 17.1%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Richards, 2025\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.06,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Seier - 12.2%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Seier, 2025\n14 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "6 Months" ~
          -0.18,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Seier - 16.7%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==

          Follow_Up ==

          -0.16,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Default

        TRUE ~
          0
        
      ),
    
    
# ============================================================
# Vertical Label Adjustments 
# ============================================================
    
    label_y =
      Weight_Loss +
      
      dplyr::case_when(
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Richards 2023 - 6.4%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Richards, 2023\n12 Weeks" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "3 Months" ~
          0.45,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Xiang - 11.2%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Xiang, 2023\n6 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "6 Months" ~
          0.45,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Zuzana - 6.45%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Miertová Zuzana , 2026\nSubmaximal dose\n6 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "3 Months" ~

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Zuzana - 11.35%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Miertová Zuzana , 2026\nSubmaximal dose\n6 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "6 Months" ~
          0.48,
        
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Rubio-Herrera - 16.9%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Rubio-Herrera, 2023\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==

# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==

          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.48,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Michalak - 15%

        Study_ID ==
          "Michalak, 2024\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.55,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------

        Study_ID ==
          "Carmen D, 2025\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==

          0.05,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Gasoyan 2025 - 10.9%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Gasoyan, 2025\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.48,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Richards 2025 - 8.1%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Richards, 2025\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "3 Months" ~
          0.65,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Richards 2025 - 17.1%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Richards, 2025\n12 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.60,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Seier - 12.2%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Seier, 2025\n14 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "6 Months" ~
          0.65,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Seier - 16.7%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Seier, 2025\n14 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.60,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Joshua - 13.4%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Toliver, 2025\n24 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "6 Months" ~
          0.45,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Joshua - 20.4%
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        Study_ID ==
          "Toliver, 2025\n24 Months" &
          Follow_Up ==
          "12+ Months" ~
          0.55,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Default

        TRUE ~
          0.45
        
      )
    
  )


# ================================================================
# STEP RANDOMIZED TRIAL benchmarkS
# ================================================================

step1_weight <- 14.9

step5_weight <- 15.2


# ------------------------------------------------
# STEP label location
# ------------------------------------------------

step_label_x <-
  max(
    weight_loss_plot$x_pos
  ) + 0.55


# ================================================================
# Create Graph
# ================================================================

p6_weight_loss <- ggplot(
  weight_loss_plot
) +
  
#================================================================
# Bars
# ================================================================

geom_col(
  
  aes(
    x = x_pos,
    y = Weight_Loss,
    fill = Follow_Up
  ),
  
  width =
    bar_width_weight,
  
  color =
    "white",
  
  linewidth =
    0.25
  
) +
  
  
# ================================================================
# Individual Value Labels 
# ================================================================

geom_text(
  
  aes(
    x = label_x,
    y = label_y,
    label = label
  ),
  
  size =
    2.65,
  
  fontface =
    "bold",
  
  color =
    "black",
  
  hjust =
    0.5,
  
  vjust =
    0
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# STEP 1 benchmark
# ================================================================

geom_hline(
  
  yintercept =
    step1_weight,
  
  linetype =
    "dashed",
  
  linewidth =
    0.65,
  
  color =
    "#7f0000"
  
) +
  
  
  annotate(
    
    "text",
    
    x =
      step_label_x,
    
    y =
      step1_weight - 0.65,
    
    label =
      "STEP 1 = 14.9%",
    
    hjust =
      0,
    
    size =
      2.65,
    
    fontface =
      "bold",
    
    color =
      "#7f0000"
    
  ) +
  
# ================================================================
# STEP 5 benchmark
# ================================================================

geom_hline(
  
  yintercept =
    step5_weight,
  
  linetype =
    "dashed",
  
  linewidth =
    0.65,
  
  color =
    "#4d9221"
  
) +
  
  
  annotate(
    
    "text",
    
    x =
      step_label_x,
    
    y =
      step5_weight + 0.65,
    
    label =
      "STEP 5 = 15.2%",
    
    hjust =
      0,
    
    size =
      2.65,
    
    fontface =
      "bold",
    
    color =
      "#4d9221"
    
  ) +
  
# ================================================================
# Follow up Colours
# ================================================================

scale_fill_manual(
  
  values = c(
    
    "3 Months" =
      "#238b45",
    
    "6 Months" =
      "#35978f",
    
    "12+ Months" =
      "#f46d43"
    
  )
  
) +
  
  
# ================================================================
#  X-Axis
# ================================================================

scale_x_continuous(
  
  breaks =
    study_centres_weight$x_center,
  
  labels =
    study_centres_weight$Study_ID,
  
  limits = c(
    
    0.40,
    
    max(
      weight_loss_plot$x_pos
    ) + 3.80
    
  ),
  
  expand =
    expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0
      )
    )
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
#  Y-Axis
# ================================================================

scale_y_continuous(
  
  limits = c(
    0,
    23
  ),
  
  breaks = seq(
    0,
    20,
    by = 5
  ),
  
  expand =
    expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0.02
      )
    )
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Internal Titles + Axis Labels
# ================================================================

labs(
  
  title =
    "Mean Percentage Weight Loss Across Included Studies at 3, 6, and 12+ Months",
  
  x =
    "Study ID",
  
  y =
    "Mean percentage weight loss (%)",
  
  fill =
    NULL
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# TUM Style Graph
# ================================================================

theme_minimal(
  base_size = 9
) +
  
  theme(
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Internal Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      
      face =
        "bold",
      
      size =
        10.5,
      
      hjust =
        0.5,
      
      color =
        "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        b = 9
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# X-Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      
      face =
        "bold",
      
      size =
        9,
      
      color =
        "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 10
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Y-Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      
      face =
        "bold",
      
      size =
        9,
      
      color =
        "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        r = 7
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Study labels
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      
      angle =
        40,
      
      hjust =
        1,
      
      vjust =
        1,
      
      size =
        6.4,
      
      color =
        "black",
      
      lineheight =
        0.88,
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 5
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Y-Axis Numbers
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      
      size =
        7.5,
      
      color =
        "black"
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Grid
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    panel.grid.major.x =
      element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.minor =
      element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      
      color =
        "#D9D9D9",
      
      linetype =
        "dashed",
      
      linewidth =
        0.40
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Legend
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    legend.position =
      "bottom",
    
    legend.direction =
      "horizontal",
    
    legend.box =
      "horizontal",
    
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 7.2
    ),
    
    legend.key.width =
      grid::unit(
        0.45,
        "cm"
      ),
    
    legend.key.height =
      grid::unit(
        0.35,
        "cm"
      ),
    
    legend.spacing.x =
      grid::unit(
        0.12,
        "cm"
      ),
    
    legend.margin =
      margin(
        t = 4
      ),
    
    legend.box.margin =
      margin(
        t = 2
      ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Plot Margins
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      
      t = 5,
      
      r = 6,
      
      b = 10,
      
      l = 6
      
    )
    
  ) +
  
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# One-row legend
# ------------------------------------------------

guides(
  
  fill = guide_legend(
    nrow = 1,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
  
)

# ================================================================
# Data
# ================================================================

threshold_data <- tibble::tribble(
  
  ~Study_ID,
  ~Duration_Order,
  ~Study_Type_Order,
  ~`≥5% Weight loss`,
  ~`≥10% Weight loss`,
  ~`≥15% Weight loss`,
  ~`≥20% Weight loss`,
  
  "Rubio-Herrera, 2023\n12 Months",
  12, 1,
  100, 86.7, 58.6, 27.6,
  
  "Michalak, 2024\n12 Months",
  12, 1,
  83.9, 74.8, 49.7, NA,
  
  "Richards, 2025\n12 Months",
  12, 1,
  NA, 83.1, 56.2, NA,
  
  "Seier, 2025\n14 Months",
  14, 1,
  98, 82, NA, 23,
  
  "Toliver, 2025\n24 Months",
  24, 1,
  NA, NA, NA, 53,
  
  "Powell, 2026\n24 Months",
  24, 1,
  66.1, 44.8, NA, NA,
  
  "STEP 1 RCT\n68 Weeks",
  68, 2,
  86.4, 69.1, 50.5, NA,
  
  "STEP 5 RCT\n104 Weeks",
  104, 2,
  77.1, 61.8, 52.1, 36.1
  
) %>%
  
  dplyr::arrange(
    Study_Type_Order,
    Duration_Order
  )


# ================================================================
# Long Format
# ================================================================

threshold_long <- threshold_data %>%
  
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    
    cols = c(
      "≥5% Weight loss",
      "≥10% Weight loss",
      "≥15% Weight loss",
      "≥20% Weight loss"
    ),
    
    names_to = "Threshold",
    
    values_to = "Percentage"
    
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Percentage)
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    Study_ID = factor(
      Study_ID,
      levels = threshold_data$Study_ID
    ),
    
    Threshold = factor(
      Threshold,
      levels = c(
        "≥5% Weight loss",
        "≥10% Weight loss",
        "≥15% Weight loss",
        "≥20% Weight loss"
      )
    )
    
  )


# ================================================================
# Bar Width
# ================================================================

bar_width_threshold <- 0.34


# ================================================================
# Study Positions
# ================================================================

study_centres_threshold <- tibble::tibble(
  
  Study_ID = factor(
    threshold_data$Study_ID,
    levels = threshold_data$Study_ID
  ),
  
  x_center = c(
    
    1.00,   # Rubio-Herrera
    
    2.55,   # Michalak
    
    3.90,   # Richards
    
    5.25,   # Seier
    
    6.60,   # Joshua
    
    7.95,   # William
    
    9.65,   # STEP 1
    
    11.20   # STEP 5
    
  )
  
)


# ================================================================
# Calculate Bar Positions
# ================================================================

threshold_plot <- threshold_long %>%
  
  dplyr::left_join(
    study_centres_threshold,
    by = "Study_ID"
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::group_by(
    Study_ID
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::arrange(
    Threshold,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    n_bars =
      dplyr::n(),
    
    bar_number =
      dplyr::row_number(),
    
    x_pos = dplyr::case_when(
      
      # One bar
      n_bars == 1 ~
        x_center,
      
      # Two bars
      n_bars == 2 &
        bar_number == 1 ~
        x_center - bar_width_threshold / 2,
      
      n_bars == 2 &
        bar_number == 2 ~
        x_center + bar_width_threshold / 2,
      
      # Three bars
      n_bars == 3 &
        bar_number == 1 ~
        x_center - bar_width_threshold,
      
      n_bars == 3 &
        bar_number == 2 ~
        x_center,
      
      n_bars == 3 &
        bar_number == 3 ~
        x_center + bar_width_threshold,
      
      # Four bars
      n_bars == 4 &
        bar_number == 1 ~
        x_center - 1.5 * bar_width_threshold,
      
      n_bars == 4 &
        bar_number == 2 ~
        x_center - 0.5 * bar_width_threshold,
      
      n_bars == 4 &
        bar_number == 3 ~
        x_center + 0.5 * bar_width_threshold,
      
      n_bars == 4 &
        bar_number == 4 ~
        x_center + 1.5 * bar_width_threshold,
      
      TRUE ~
        x_center
    ),
    
    label =
      paste0(
        Percentage,
        "%"
      )
    
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::ungroup()


# ================================================================
# Individual Label Adjustments
# ================================================================

threshold_plot <- threshold_plot %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    
# ============================================================
# Horizontal Label Position
# ============================================================
    
    label_x = x_pos +
      
      dplyr::case_when(
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Rubio-Herrera
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        # 86.7%
        Study_ID == "Rubio-Herrera, 2023\n12 Months" &
          Threshold == "≥10% Weight loss" ~
          0.14,
        
        # 58.6%
        Study_ID == "Rubio-Herrera, 2023\n12 Months" &
          Threshold == "≥15% Weight loss" ~
          0.13,
        
        # 27.6%
        Study_ID == "Rubio-Herrera, 2023\n12 Months" &
          Threshold == "≥20% Weight loss" ~
          0.13,
        
        
        # --------------------------------------------------------
        # Michalak
        # --------------------------------------------------------
        
        # 83.9%
        Study_ID == "Michalak, 2024\n12 Months" &
          Threshold == "≥5% Weight loss" ~
          0.14,
        
        # 74.8%
        Study_ID == "Michalak, 2024\n12 Months" &
          Threshold == "≥10% Weight loss" ~
          0.14,
        
        # 49.7%
        Study_ID == "Michalak, 2024\n12 Months" &
          Threshold == "≥15% Weight loss" ~
          0.13,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# RICHARDS
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        # 56.2%
        Study_ID == "Richards, 2025\n12 Months" &
          Threshold == "≥15% Weight loss" ~
          0.13,
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# Seier
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        # 82%
        Study_ID == "Seier, 2025\n14 Months" &
          Threshold == "≥10% Weight loss" ~
          0.10,
        
        # 23%
        Study_ID == "Seier, 2025\n14 Months" &
          Threshold == "≥20% Weight loss" ~
          0.09,  
        
# --------------------------------------------------------
# WILLIAM
# --------------------------------------------------------
        
        # 44.8%

# ================================================================
# Create Graph
# ================================================================

p7_threshold <- ggplot(
  threshold_plot
) +
  
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Bars
# ------------------------------------------------

geom_col(
  
  aes(
    x = x_pos,
    y = Percentage,
    fill = Threshold
  ),
  
  width =
    bar_width_threshold,
  
  color =
    "white",
  
  linewidth =
    0.25
  
) +
  
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Labels
# ------------------------------------------------

geom_text(
  
  aes(
    x = label_x,
    y = label_y,
    label = label
  ),
  
  size =
    2.65,
  
  fontface =
    "bold",
  
  color =
    "black",
  
  hjust =
    0.5,
  
  vjust =
    0
  
) +
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Divider
# ------------------------------------------------

geom_vline(
  
  xintercept =
    divider_x,
  
  linetype =
    "dashed",
  
  color =
    "black",
  
  linewidth =
    0.55
  
) +
  
# ================================================================

scale_fill_manual(

    "≥5% Weight loss" =

  )
  
) +

        0
      )
    )
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
#  Y-Axis

scale_y_continuous(
  
  limits = c(
    0,
    110
  ),

    0,
    100,
    by = 20
  ),
  
  expand =
    expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0
      )
    )
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Titles / Labels

labs(
  
  title =

  x =
    "Study ID",
  
  y =

) +

    clip = "off"

# ================================================================

) +

      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 6.4,
      color = "black",
      lineheight = 0.88,
      margin = margin(t = 5)
    ),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 7.5,
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    panel.grid.major.x =
      element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.minor =

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "#D9D9D9",

    ),

      "horizontal",

    legend.text =

        size = 7.2
      ),

      ),

# ================================================================
# Cardiovascular Outcomes: George Komatsoulis 2025 vs SELECT Trial
# ================================================================

cv_event_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Outcome, ~`George Komatsoulis, 2025\n11.7 Months\nSemaglutide Group`, ~`SELECT Trial\n2.9 Years\nSemaglutide Group`,
  "Composite\ncardiovascular\nendpoint", 1.2, 6.5,
  "All-cause mortality", 0.2, 4.3,
  "Myocardial infarction", 0.4, 2.7,
  "Stroke", 0.6, 1.7
)

cv_event_long <- cv_event_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      "George Komatsoulis, 2025\n11.7 Months\nSemaglutide Group",
      "SELECT Trial\n2.9 Years\nSemaglutide Group"
    ),
    names_to = "Group",
    values_to = "Event_Rate"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Outcome = factor(
      Outcome,
      levels = c(
        "Composite\ncardiovascular\nendpoint",
        "All-cause mortality",
        "Myocardial infarction",
        "Stroke"
      )
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "George Komatsoulis, 2025\n11.7 Months\nSemaglutide Group",
        "SELECT Trial\n2.9 Years\nSemaglutide Group"
      )
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------
# Bars Width
# ------------------------------------------------

bar_width_cv <- 0.48

outcome_centres_cv <- tibble::tibble(
  Outcome = factor(
    c(
      "Composite\ncardiovascular\nendpoint",
      "All-cause mortality",
      "Myocardial infarction",
      "Stroke"
    ),
    levels = levels(cv_event_long$Outcome)
  ),
  x_center = c(0.95, 2.05, 3.15, 4.25)
)

cv_event_plot <- cv_event_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(outcome_centres_cv, by = "Outcome") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x_pos = dplyr::case_when(
      Group == "George Komatsoulis, 2025\n11.7 Months\nSemaglutide Group" ~ x_center - bar_width_cv / 2,
      Group == "SELECT Trial\n2.9 Years\nSemaglutide Group" ~ x_center + bar_width_cv / 2
    ),
    
    label = paste0(Event_Rate, "%"),
    
    # Values adjusted clearly above each bar
    label_x = dplyr::case_when(
      Group == "George Komatsoulis, 2025\n11.7 Months\nSemaglutide Group" ~ x_pos,
      Group == "SELECT Trial\n2.9 Years\nSemaglutide Group" ~ x_pos
    ),
    
    label_y = dplyr::case_when(
      Event_Rate <= 0.3 ~ Event_Rate + 0.20,
      Event_Rate <= 0.7 ~ Event_Rate + 0.18,
      Event_Rate <= 1.5 ~ Event_Rate + 0.15,
      Event_Rate <= 3.0 ~ Event_Rate + 0.13,
      TRUE ~ Event_Rate + 0.12
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------

p_cv_event <- ggplot(cv_event_plot) +
  geom_col(
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = Event_Rate,
      fill = Group
    ),
    width = bar_width_cv,
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = label_x,
      y = label_y,
      label = label
    ),
    size = 4.1,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "George Komatsoulis, 2025\n11.7 Months\nSemaglutide Group" = "#fdbb84",
      "SELECT Trial\n2.9 Years\nSemaglutide Group" = "#e34a33"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = outcome_centres_cv$x_center,
    labels = outcome_centres_cv$Outcome,
    limits = c(0.45, 4.75),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 7.5),
    breaks = seq(0, 7, by = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Cardiovascular Outcomes: George Komatsoulis,2025 (11.7 months) vs SELECT Trial (2.9 years)",
    x = "Outcome",
    y = "Event rate (%)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 20,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 13,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(t = 15)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "#000000",
      linetype = "dashed"
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 25, 10)
  )

# ================================================================
# Display Graph
# ================================================================

print(p_cv_event)

# ================================================================
# Graph Save
# ================================================================

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "8_cv_event_rates_labels_adjusted_final.png"),
  plot = p_cv_event,
  width = 14,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white")


# ================================================================
# Graph 9: Themes for Discontinuation
# Vertical Bars +Secondary Percentage Axis + Shape Trend Lines
# ================================================================

# ---------------------------
# Data
# ---------------------------

disc_theme_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Theme, ~No_of_Studies,
  "Tolerability\nIssues", 12,
  "Medication\nAvailability", 6,
  "Cost and Insurance\nBarriers", 9,
  "Patient Perceived\nSuccess", 2,
  "Patient Perceived\nFailure", 5
)

disc_theme_data <- disc_theme_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Theme = factor(
      Theme,
      levels = c(
        "Tolerability\nIssues",
        "Medication\nAvailability",
        "Cost and Insurance\nBarriers",
        "Patient Perceived\nSuccess",
        "Patient Perceived\nFailure"
      )
    ),
    x_pos = dplyr::row_number()
  )

# ---------------------------
# Secondary-Axis Reference lines
# Right Axis: Discontinuation Percentage
# Left Axis: Number of Studies
#
# Left Axis Range = 0 to 14
# Right Axis Range = 0 to 20
# Therefore Percentage Values Must Be Converted to Left-Axis Scale:
# y_Left = Percentage * 14 / 20
# ---------------------------

select_pct <- 16.6
step1_pct <- 4.5
step5_pct  <- 5.9

scale_left_max <- 14
scale_right_max <- 20

select_y <- select_pct * scale_left_max / scale_right_max
step1_y <- step1_pct * scale_left_max / scale_right_max
step5_y  <- step5_pct  * scale_left_max / scale_right_max

trend_line_data <- tibble::tibble(
  x_pos = seq(0.65, 5.35, length.out = 18),
  SELECT = select_y,
  STEP1 = step1_y,
  STEP5 = step5_y
)

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------

p9_disc_theme <- ggplot() +
  
  # Bars
  geom_col(
    data = disc_theme_data,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = No_of_Studies),
    width = 0.62,
    fill = "#01665e"
  ) +
  
  # Number labels above bars
  geom_text(
    data = disc_theme_data,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = No_of_Studies + 0.25,
      label = No_of_Studies
    ),
    size = 4.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # SELECT trial trend line with circular shapes
  geom_line(
    data = trend_line_data,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = SELECT, color = "SELECT trial = 16.6%"),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = trend_line_data,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = SELECT, color = "SELECT trial = 16.6%"),
    shape = 16,
    size = 2.6
  ) +
  
  # STEP 1 trend line with triangle shapes
  geom_line(
    data = trend_line_data,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = STEP1, color = "STEP 1 = 4.5%"),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = trend_line_data,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = STEP1, color = "STEP 1 = 4.5%"),
    shape = 17,
    size = 3.0
  ) +
  ## STEP 5 trend line with square shapes
  geom_line(
    data = trend_line_data,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = STEP5, color = "STEP 5 = 5.9%"),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = trend_line_data,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = STEP5, color = "STEP 5 = 5.9%"),
    shape = 15,
    size = 3.0
  ) +
  
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 3.5,
    y = 12.7,
    label = "Discontinuation was\nrelated to tolerability issues.",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.6,
    fontface = "italic",
    color = "black"
  )  +
  
  # Colors for trend lines
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "SELECT trial = 16.6%" = "#66bd63",
      "STEP 1 = 4.5%" = "#d6604d",  "STEP 5 = 5.9%"        = "#7a0177"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  
  #  X-Axis
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = disc_theme_data$x_pos,
    labels = disc_theme_data$Theme,
    limits = c(0.5, 5.5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  
  # Left axis + right percentage axis
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of studies",
    limits = c(0, 14),
    breaks = seq(0, 14, by = 2),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ . * scale_right_max / scale_left_max,
      name = "Discontinuation percentage (%)",
      breaks = seq(0, 20, by = 5)
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Themes for Discontinuation Across Included Studies",
    x = "Theme for discontinuation"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 20,
      hjust = 0.5,
      color = "black",
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15,
      color = "black",
      margin = margin(t = 15)
    ),
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15,
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 12,
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12,
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "#d9d9d9",
      linetype = "dashed"
    ),
    
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 11,
      face = "italic",
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(t = 20)
    ),
    
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 25, 20)
  )

    names_to = "Follow_up_period",
    
    values_to = "Number_of_studies"
    
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    Theme = factor(
      Theme,
      levels = disc_theme_data$Theme
    ),
    
    Follow_up_period = factor(
      Follow_up_period,
      levels = c(
        "3 months",
        "6 months",
        "12+ months"
      )
    )
    
  )


# ================================================================
# Total Labels Above Each Bars
# ================================================================

theme_totals <- disc_theme_long %>%
  
  dplyr::group_by(
    Theme
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::summarise(
    
    Total = sum(
      Number_of_studies
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
    
  )


# ================================================================
# Plot
# ================================================================

p_discontinuation_themes <- ggplot(
  
  disc_theme_long,
  
  aes(
    x = Theme,
    y = Number_of_studies,
    fill = Follow_up_period
  )
  
) +
  
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Stacked Bars
# ------------------------------------------------

geom_col(
  
  width = 0.68,
  
  color = "white",
  
  linewidth = 0.45
  
) +
  
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Numbers Inside Bar Segment
# ------------------------------------------------

geom_text(
  
  aes(
    label = ifelse(
      Number_of_studies > 0,
      Number_of_studies,
      ""
    )
  ),
  
  position = position_stack(
    vjust = 0.50
  ),
  
  size = 2.65,
  
  fontface = "bold",
  
  color = "black"
  
) +
  
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Total Number Above Each Bar
# ------------------------------------------------

geom_text(
  
  data = theme_totals,
  
  aes(
    x = Theme,
    y = Total + 0.25,
    label = Total
  ),
  
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  
  size = 3.5,
  
  fontface = "bold",
  
  color = "black"
  
) +
  
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Colours
# ------------------------------------------------

scale_fill_manual(
  
  values = c(
    
    "3 months" =
      "#238b45",
    
    "6 months" =
      "#35978f",
    
    "12+ months" =
      "#f46d43"
    
  )
  
) +
  
# ------------------------------------------------
#  Y-Axis
# ------------------------------------------------

scale_y_continuous(
  
  limits = c(
    0,
    12
  ),
  
  breaks = seq(
    0,
    12,
    by = 2
  ),
  
  expand = expansion(
    mult = c(
      0,
      0.02
    )
  )
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Internal Titles + Axis Labels
# ================================================================

labs(
  
  title =
    "Themes for Discontinuation Across Included Studies by Follow-up Period",
  
  x =
    "Theme for discontinuation",
  
  y =
    "Number of studies",
  
  fill =
    "Follow-up period"
  
) +
  
# ------------------------------------------------
# Legend
# ------------------------------------------------

guides(
  
  fill = guide_legend(
    
    nrow = 1,
    
    title.position = "top",
    
    title.hjust = 0.5,
    
    byrow = TRUE
    
  )
  
) +
  

theme_minimal(
  base_size = 9
) +
  
  theme(
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Internal Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 10.5,
      
      hjust = 0.5,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        b = 9
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 9.5,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 9
      )
      
    ),
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 9.5,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        r = 7
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Theme Category Label
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      
      size = 8.3,
      
      color = "black",
      
      lineheight = 0.90,
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 4
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Y-Axis Numbers
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      
      size = 8,
      
      color = "black"
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Grid
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    panel.grid.major.x =
      element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.minor =
      element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      
      color = "#D0D0D0",
      
      linetype = "dashed",
      
      linewidth = 0.40
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Legend
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    legend.position =
      "bottom",
    
    legend.title = element_text(
      
      size = 8,
      
      face = "plain"
      
    ),
    
    legend.text = element_text(
      
      size = 7.5
      
    ),
    
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(
      0.65,
      "cm"
    ),
    
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(
      0.35,
      "cm"
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Plot Margins
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      
      t = 5,
      
      r = 6,
      
      b = 6,
      
      l = 6
      
    )

)

  "Tirzepatide", "Adverse events /\nsafety", 1, 339,
  "Tirzepatide", "Utilization /\nexposure", 3, 18136,
  
  "Liraglutide", "Weight / BMI\noutcomes", 2, 3491,
  "Liraglutide", "Adherence /\ndiscontinuation", 2, 3491,
  "Liraglutide", "Adverse events /\nsafety", 1, 102,
  "Liraglutide", "Utilization /\nexposure", 2, 3491,
  "Liraglutide", "Additional health\nbenefits", 1, 102,
  
  "Bariatric history comparison", "Weight / BMI\noutcomes", 1, 1072,

  "Life style counselling alone", "Weight / BMI\noutcomes", 1, 6664,
  "Life style counselling alone", "Adherence /\ndiscontinuation", 1, 6664,
  "Life style counselling alone", "Utilization /\nexposure", 1, 6664,

  "other GLP-1 RAs", "Adherence /\ndiscontinuation", 1, 4066,
  
  "AOM", "Additional health\nbenefits", 1, 91408,
  
  "No exposure to any GLP-1 RAs", "Cardiovascular\noutcomes", 1, 76468,
  
  "Non-GLP-1RA AOM", "Adherence /\ndiscontinuation", 2, 315960,
  "Non-GLP-1RA AOM", "Utilization /\nexposure", 3, 399785,
  "Non-GLP-1RA AOM", "Additional health\nbenefits", 3, 399785
)

outcome_levels <- c(

  "Utilization /\nexposure",

)

  )

p11_bubble <- ggplot(

) +

  ) +

      size = 10,
      color = "black"
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "#D9D9D9",
      linetype = "dashed"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(t = 18)
    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 25, 35, 15)
  )

  range = c(
    4.5,
    16
  ),
  
  guide = "none"
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Bubble Colour Represents Number of Studies
# ================================================================

scale_fill_gradientn(
  
  colors = c(
    
    "#80DEEA",
    
    "#81C784",
    
    "#FFF176",
    
    "#FFB74D",
    
    "#CE93D8"
    
  ),
  
  limits = c(
    1,
    8
  ),
  
  breaks = seq(
    1,
    8,
    by = 1
  ),
  
  guide = "none"
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
#  X-Axis
# ================================================================

scale_x_discrete(
  
  expand = expansion(
    add = c(
      0.35,
      0.70
    )
  )
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
#  Y-Axis
# ================================================================

scale_y_discrete(
  
  expand = expansion(
    add = c(
      0.55,
      0.55
    )
  )
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Internal Titles + Axis Labels
# ================================================================

labs(
  
  title =
    "Comparator Type × Outcome Measure",
  
  x =
    "Outcome measure category",
  
  y =
    "Comparator category"
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Keep Labels Inside
# ================================================================

coord_cartesian(
  clip = "off"
) +
  
# ================================================================
# TUM Style Graph
# ================================================================

theme_minimal(
  base_size = 9
) +
  
  theme(
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Internal Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 10.5,
      
      hjust = 0.5,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        b = 9
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# X-Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 9,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 9
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Y-Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 9,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        r = 8
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Outcome Category Labels
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      
      size = 7.2,
      
      color = "black",
      
      lineheight = 0.90,
      
      hjust = 0.5,
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 5
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Comparator Labels
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      
      size = 7.2,
      
      color = "black",
      
      lineheight = 0.90,
      
      margin = margin(
        r = 5
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Grid
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      
      color = "#D9D9D9",
      
      linetype = "dashed",
      
      linewidth = 0.40
      
    ),
    
    panel.grid.minor =
      element_blank(),
    
    legend.position =
      "none",
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Plot Margins
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      
      t = 5,
      
      r = 14,
      
      b = 7,
      
      l = 6
      
    )
    
  )

# Display Graph

print(

)

)
```
