# Graph 12: Outcome Measures by Data Source Category
# Heat Map
# ================================================================

heatmap_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Data_Source_Category, ~`Weight / BMI\noutcomes`, ~`Adherence /\ndiscontinuation`, ~`Adverse events /\nsafety`, ~`Cardiovascular\noutcomes`, ~`Utilization /\nexposure`, ~`Additional health\nbenefits`,
  "Digital Health Category", 4, 1, 2, 0, 4, 0,
  "Electronic Health Record Data", 8, 8, 3, 1, 10, 6,
  "Linked electronic health records\nand administrative claims data", 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0,
  "Health Insurance claim data", 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0,
  "Patient registry", 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0,
  "Pharmacovigilance data", 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0,
  "REDCap electronic data", 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1
)

data_source_levels <- c(
  "Digital Health Category",
  "Electronic Health Record Data",
  "Linked electronic health records\nand administrative claims data",
  "Health Insurance claim data",
  "Patient registry",
  "Pharmacovigilance data",
  "REDCap electronic data"
)

outcome_levels_heatmap <- c(
  "Weight / BMI\noutcomes",
  "Adherence /\ndiscontinuation",
  "Adverse events /\nsafety",
  "Cardiovascular\noutcomes",
  "Utilization /\nexposure",
  "Additional health\nbenefits"
)

heatmap_long <- heatmap_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -Data_Source_Category,
    names_to = "Outcome_Category",
    values_to = "No_of_Studies"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Data_Source_Category = factor(
      Data_Source_Category,
      levels = rev(data_source_levels)
    ),
    Outcome_Category = factor(
      Outcome_Category,
      levels = outcome_levels_heatmap
    ),
    label = ifelse(No_of_Studies == 0, "", as.character(No_of_Studies))
  )

p12_heatmap <- ggplot(
  heatmap_long,
  aes(
    x = Outcome_Category,
    y = Data_Source_Category,
    fill = No_of_Studies
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = NA) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c(
      "#440154",
      "#482878",
      "#3E4989",
      "#26828E",
      "#35B779",
      "#B8DE29",
      "#FDE725"
    ),
    limits = c(0, 10),
    breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 1),
    name = "Number of studies"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Outcome Measures by Data Source Category",
    x = "Outcome measure category",
    y = "Data source category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 22,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(b = 20)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      margin = margin(t = 15)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      margin = margin(r = 12)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 11,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 11,
      color = "black"
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(t = 18)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 25, 35, 15)
  )

# ================================================================
# Display Graph
# ================================================================

print(p12_heatmap)

# Graph Save

save_plot(

)

# Panel B: Outcome Measures by Data Source Category

# ------------------------------------------------
# Output Folder

out_dir <- file.path(
  getwd(),
  "Saved_Graphs"
)

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}


# ================================================================
# Data
# Panel A: Cumulative Sample Size by Data Source Category
# ================================================================

sample_size_data <- tibble::tribble(
  
  ~Data_Source_Category, ~Sample_Size,
  
  "Electronic Health Record Data",
  18715605,
  
  "Linked electronic health records\nand administrative claims data",
  10706468,
  
  "Patient Registry",
  71639,
  
  "Pharmacovigilance Data",
  22287,
  
  "Digital Health Category",
  11323,
  
  "Health Insurance Claim Data",
  4066,
  
  "REDCap Electronic Data",
  3389
  
)


# ================================================================
# Prepare Panel Position And Labels
# ================================================================

sample_size_data <- sample_size_data %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    y_pos =
      dplyr::row_number(),
    
    label = paste0(
      "n=",
      scales::comma(
        Sample_Size
      )
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Largest Values Kept Inside the Plotting Area
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    label_x = dplyr::case_when(
      
      Sample_Size >= 1000000 ~
        Sample_Size / 1.08,
      
      TRUE ~
        Sample_Size * 1.12
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Small Vertical Adjustment for Largest Labels
# ----------------------------------------------
    
    label_y = dplyr::case_when(
      
      Sample_Size >= 1000000 ~
        y_pos + 0.24,
      
      TRUE ~
        y_pos
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Label Justification
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    label_hjust = dplyr::case_when(
      
      Sample_Size >= 1000000 ~
        1,
      
      TRUE ~
        0
      
    )
    
  )


# ================================================================
# Panel A:
# Cumulative Sample Size Lollipop Chart
# ================================================================

p13_lollipop <- ggplot(
  sample_size_data
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Horizontal Lollipop LInes
# ================================================================

geom_segment(
  
  aes(
    x = 1,
    xend = Sample_Size,
    y = y_pos,
    yend = y_pos
  ),
  
  linewidth = 0.65,
  
  color = "#2C7FB8"
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# End Points
# ================================================================

geom_point(
  
  aes(
    x = Sample_Size,
    y = y_pos
  ),
  
  size = 2.7,
  
  color = "#2C7FB8"
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Sample Size Labels
# ================================================================

geom_text(
  
  aes(
    x = label_x,
    y = label_y,
    label = label,
    hjust = label_hjust
  ),
  
  size = 2.65,
  
  fontface = "bold",
  
  color = "black"
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Logarthmic X-Axis
# ================================================================

scale_x_log10(
  
  breaks = c(
    10,
    1000,
    100000,
    10000000
  ),
  
  labels =
    scales::comma,
  
  limits = c(
    1,
    30000000
  ),
  
  expand = expansion(
    mult = c(
      0.02,
      0.03
    )
  )
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
#  Y-Axis
# ================================================================

scale_y_continuous(
  
  breaks =
    sample_size_data$y_pos,
  
  labels =
    sample_size_data$Data_Source_Category,
  
  trans =
    "reverse"
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Panel A Title + Axis Labels
# ================================================================

labs(
  
  title =
    "A. Cumulative Sample Size by Data Source Category",
  
  x =
    "Cumulative sample size, log scale",
  
  y =
    "Data source category"
  
) +
  
  
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  

# ================================================================
# Panel A TUM Style
# ================================================================

theme_minimal(
  base_size = 9
) +
  
  theme(
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Panel Heading
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 10.5,
      
      hjust = 0,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        b = 8
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# X-Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 9,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 7
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Y-Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 9,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        r = 8
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# X-Axis Values
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      
      size = 7.5,
      
      color = "black"
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Data-Source Category Labels
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      
      size = 7.5,
      
      color = "black",
      
      lineheight = 0.90
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Grid
# Vertical Grid Retained Because Panel A Uses a Log-Scaled Horizontal Quantitative Axis.
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    panel.grid.major.y =
      element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.minor =
      element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      
      color = "#D9D9D9",
      
      linetype = "dashed",
      
      linewidth = 0.40
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Panel Margins
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      
      t = 5,
      
      r = 12,
      
      b = 5,
      
      l = 5
      
    )
    
  )


# ================================================================
# Panel B Data
# Outcome Measures by Data Source Category
# ================================================================

heatmap_data <- tibble::tribble(
  
  ~Data_Source_Category,
  ~`Weight / BMI\noutcomes`,
  ~`Adherence /\ndiscontinuation`,
  ~`Adverse events /\nsafety`,
  ~`Cardiovascular\noutcomes`,
  ~`Utilization /\nexposure`,
  ~`Additional health\nbenefits`,
  
  "Digital Health Category",
  4, 1, 2, 0, 4, 0,
  
  "Electronic Health Record Data",
  5, 7, 1, 1, 8, 5,
  
  "Linked electronic health records\nand administrative claims data",
  1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0,
  
  "Health Insurance Claim Data",
  1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0,
  
  "Patient Registry",
  0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0,
  
  "Pharmacovigilance Data",
  0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0,
  
  "Clinic-Based Data",
  3, 1, 2, 0, 2, 1,
  
  "REDCap Electronic Data",
  1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1
  
)


# ================================================================
# Data Source Order
# ================================================================

data_source_levels_heatmap <- c(
  
  "Digital Health Category",
  
  "Electronic Health Record Data",
  
  "Linked electronic health records\nand administrative claims data",
  
  "Health Insurance Claim Data",
  
  "Patient Registry",
  
  "Pharmacovigilance Data",
  
  "Clinic-Based Data",
  
  "REDCap Electronic Data"
  
)


# ================================================================
# Outcome Category Order
# ================================================================

outcome_levels_heatmap <- c(
  
  "Weight / BMI\noutcomes",
  
  "Adherence /\ndiscontinuation",
  
  "Adverse events /\nsafety",
  
  "Cardiovascular\noutcomes",
  
  "Utilization /\nexposure",
  
  "Additional health\nbenefits"
  
)


# ================================================================
# Convert Panel B To Long Format
# ================================================================

heatmap_long <- heatmap_data %>%
  
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    
    cols =
      -Data_Source_Category,
    
    names_to =
      "Outcome_Category",
    
    values_to =
      "No_of_Studies"
    
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    Data_Source_Category = factor(
      
      Data_Source_Category,
      
      levels = rev(
        data_source_levels_heatmap
      )
      
    ),
    
    Outcome_Category = factor(
      
      Outcome_Category,
      
      levels =
        outcome_levels_heatmap
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Zero Cells Shown Without Number
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    label = ifelse(
      
      No_of_Studies == 0,
      
      "",
      
      as.character(
        No_of_Studies
      )
      
    )
    
  )


# ================================================================
# Panel B:
# Outcome Coverage Heat Map
# ================================================================

p13_heatmap <- ggplot(
  
  heatmap_long,
  
  aes(
    x = Outcome_Category,
    y = Data_Source_Category,
    fill = No_of_Studies
  )
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Heat Map Cells
# ================================================================

geom_tile(
  
  color = "#D0D0D0",
  
  linewidth = 0.35
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Numbers Inside Cells
# ================================================================

geom_text(
  
  aes(
    label = label
  ),
  
  size = 2.65,
  
  fontface = "bold",
  
  color = "black"
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Heat Map Colour Scale
# ================================================================

scale_fill_gradientn(
  
  colours = c(
    
    "white",
    
    "#482878",
    
    "#3E4989",
    
    "#26828E",
    
    "#35B779",
    
    "#B8DE29",
    
    "#FDE725"
    
  ),
  
  values = scales::rescale(
    c(
      0,
      1,
      2,
      4,
      5,
      7,
      8
    )
  ),
  
  limits = c(
    0,
    8
  ),
  
  breaks = seq(
    0,
    8,
    by = 1
  ),
  
  name =
    "Number of studies"
  
) +
  
  
# ================================================================
# Colour Legend
# ================================================================

guides(
  
  fill = guide_colorbar(
    
    title.position =
      "top",
    
    title.hjust =
      0.5,
    
    direction =
      "horizontal",
    
    barwidth =
      grid::unit(
        2.3,
        "in"
      ),
    
    barheight =
      grid::unit(
        0.12,
        "in"
      )
    
  )
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Panel B Title + Axis Labels
# ================================================================

labs(
  
  title =
    "B. Outcome Measures by Data Source Category",
  
  x =
    "Outcome measure category",
  
  y =
    "Data source category"
  
) +
  
# ================================================================
# Panel B TUM Style
# ================================================================

theme_minimal(
  base_size = 9
) +
  
  theme(
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Panel Heading
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 10.5,
      
      hjust = 0,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        b = 8
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# X-Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 9,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 9
      )
      
    ),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Y-Axis Titles
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 9,
      
      color = "black",
      
      margin = margin(
        r = 8
      )
      
    ),
    
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Outcome-Category Labels
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      
      size = 7.0,
      
      color = "black",
      
      lineheight = 0.90,
      
      margin = margin(
        t = 4
      )
      
    ),
    
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Data-Source Labels
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      
      size = 7.5,
      
      color = "black",
      
      lineheight = 0.90
      
    ),
    
    
    panel.grid =
      element_blank(),
    
# ------------------------------------------------
# Legend
# ------------------------------------------------
    
    legend.position =
      "bottom",
    
    legend.direction =
      "horizontal",
    
    legend.title = element_text(
      
      face = "bold",
      
      size = 7.2
      
    ),
    
    legend.text = element_text(

      l = 5
